regions.today: A mix of sunny spells with scattered showers this afternoon. Becoming mostly cloudy with more widespread showers or longer spells of rain pushing up from the south later this afternoon and evening. Some heavy and potentially thundery downpours are possible, bringing a risk of spot flooding, especially in southern parts. It’ll be humid with highest temperatures of 20 to 24 degrees in light to moderate southeasterly winds.
regions.tonight: Heavy showers or downpours at first tonight will bring a continued risk of spot flooding. The showers will gradually ease overnight. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: After a mostly cloudy and misty start tomorrow, sunny spells will gradually develop, along with scattered showers. Some of the showers will be heavy or possibly thundery. Continuing humid with highest temperatures of 21 to 23 degrees in a light southwest breeze, veering moderate westerly in the evening.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate ot high today and tomorrow.
